text_block_list.text:
Still in Love stands in the plaza under the gentle sunlight.
With an expression that looks as if she's lost in thought...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Um... there's just a little something
troubling me...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: We've arranged to gather with some fellow coffee lovers in Cafe-san's room soon.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
So, I tried making a test batch
of the sweets we're supposed to bring, but...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I'm a little unsure if the sweets I tried making turned out alright... so I've been fretting over it a bit...
choice_data_list: What kind of sweets did you make?
What kind of sweets did you make?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Here it is... an apple sandwich cookie.
Would you like to try one, if you'd like?

Biting into the cookie brought a gentle tartness of apple
and a subtle aroma of spices.
It wasn't overly sweet, with a pleasantly crisp, refined flavor—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I am so glad...
I tried to match the aroma with the Guatemalan blend
you will be serving next time.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I think the flavors are well-balanced.
Still, it feels like it's missing just a little something...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I feel like... there's still a little more we could do.
Since everyone gathered all the way here, after all.
choice_data_list: Then why not try pairing it with real coffee?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
! Indeed...
Now that it's finished, I haven't tried
pairing it with coffee yet.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Besides... taking in the aroma of coffee might give you some inspiration.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I don't think... we have Guatemalan beans right now...
I'll have to... go buy some later...
choice_data_list: If you want, I'll come with you!
If you'd like, I'll come with you!

text_block_list.text:
Together with Still in Love,
I visited a coffee roastery with an attached café.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Could I get 200 grams
of this Guatemala, please?

text_block_list.name: Roaster
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
How would you like it roasted?
Medium roast is standard for Guatemala, but—

text_block_list.name: Roaster
text_block_list.text:
If roasted a bit darker and made into a café latte,
it brings out a whole different charm.
If you're interested, I can prepare a sample for you to taste.
choice_data_list: Since we're here, wanna give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I'm looking forward to seeing... how it changes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Beautiful...
To think it could make patterns like this...

Delicate latte art made with milk adorned the cup.
A leaf pattern quietly spreading across the surface.
choice_data_list: Things like this just kind of make you happy, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Not just the taste, but being
'entertained' like this makes me so happy...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It felt like you made it a special experience for me—
............Ah.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I... I think I might have just figured it out...!
And so, the day of the coffee party arrived.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "The coffee you brewed, Cafe-san, has such a lovely, rich aroma... It's truly wonderful."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And the cookies Still-san brought along too.
The flavor of the cookies perfectly complements
the acidity and bitterness of the coffee...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"It's also great that you can change the flavor depending on the filling.
Apple butter, honey, custard..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Depending on which one they choose, it could spark a lively conversation.
Perhaps we should serve these to visitors at the Expedition Support Committee as well?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I really like this apple butter.
It complements the richness of the Guatemala so well,
like adding flowers to brocade.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Your use of spices is truly magnificent. Serving it with honey reminded me of the Lebkuchen my father used to bake.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Not only does it pair well with coffee,
but choosing brings its own delight...
A truly wonderful accompaniment.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... I'm so glad
to hear that you like it.

A few days later, as I was working on paperwork,
a sweet, rich aroma gently wafted into the room.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, would you care for a cup?
I brewed it with the beans I bought the other day...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
To go with the coffee,
I also baked the cookies from the other day...

"The acidity of the Guatemalan coffee and the sweetness of the cookie
spread through my mouth... In the quiet, the aroma and sweetness
filled the air, bringing a natural smile to my face."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Sweets and coffee...
It truly is bliss...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I feel so relieved... and fulfilled.
Filled with a calm, gentle warmth...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why I want to be particular about it. So that it may bring a deeper, fuller satisfaction..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
That party... Thanks to you,
it turned out to be truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Truly... thank you very much.
choice_data_list: I'm glad you were able to enjoy such a blissful time.
I'm glad you got to enjoy such a blissful time!
Are you particular about how you brew your coffee, too?
Are you particular about how you brew your coffee, too?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Truly... thank you very much.
choice_data_list: I'm glad you were able to enjoy such a blissful time.
I'm glad you got to enjoy such a blissful time!
Are you particular about how you brew your coffee, too?
Are you particular about how you brew your coffee, too?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
If there is ever another chance... I would love to spend time like this again...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Enjoying sweets and coffee,
chatting with everyone... That warm, precious time...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, just a little.
The water temperature and the speed of the pour...
they change how the aroma blooms.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
what kind of fragrance do you prefer?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Please... tell me.
